title: Mixed Event — The BEST Summer Ever! — Episode7 The Story We Put Together

meta.Episode: Episode7 — The Story We Put Together
meta.Event Outline: The Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy first years arrive at the Seaside School. Finding themselves allocated to the same group for the school's annual presentation event, Honami, Saki, Emu, and Kohane put their showmanship skills to the test by performing a song from a musical.

rows.Line: Lodge Gym

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Shiho's been gone a long time...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right. She did mention something about Tenma's group needing a little more time before they perform...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, right... I've been meaning to ask Kohane about that since she's in Saki's group, but I haven't seen her for a while now either...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, there go the lights. Does this mean that they're about to start...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? Wait, is that...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone♪
Welcome to Saki and Emu's magic show!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We were actually supposed to do our real performance now, but we ran into some trouble and need a little more time to get ready...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We apologize for making you all wait like this! But in the meantime, we'd like to do a magic show for you! We hope you like it♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They ran into some trouble? So they're doing a magic show instead...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't really understand either, but I guess they're buying time for their other group members...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, I hope you're ready.
Presenting our great magician, Emu!
Stage Wing

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line: <Emu! Can you hear me?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! Loud and clear☆ But it's funny how you're sitting in my pocket like this, Miku♪

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line: <Right? It's like I'm your fairy companion.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Especially since we're the same height in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Anyway, Miku, I'll be counting on your help...!

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line: <You got it! I'll tell you exactly what you need to do, so don't worry☆>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Alright, let's use our magic to make everyone smile!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Lodge Gym

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's give our star a big round of applause!!
se_event_summer_2021_007

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hi, everybody!!
Welcome to our magic show!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Let's start with an extra special trick☆
Out of this hat, many things will appear!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, this is better than I expected! I can't wait to see what happens!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me too. Otori's a seasoned stage performer, so I'm sure she'll do great.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Now, Saki, if you'll repeat after me...♪
Cards! Cards! Wherever you are!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay!
Uh... Cards! Cards! Wherever you are!
se_event_summer_2021_003

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ta-daah!
Cards everywhere!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa, that's amazing...!
So many playing cards...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! Was she hiding all those cards in her hat?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Maybe, I'm not sure...! I wonder how she did it...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Honami and Kohane still aren't back yet, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Shiho said that she'll give us a signal when they did...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I'm sure they're doing their best. That means Saki and I need to keep trying too...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Next, these cards will magically turn into... Mr. Fishy!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What? Mr. Fishy?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Three, two, one... Wonderhoy!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa, they turned into a fish plushie!
se_event_summer_2021_007

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Haruka, that was so cool!
How on earth did she just do that?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I don't know either.
It's also incredible how they had time to work on this alongside their actual performance...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And to finish, let's return our little fishy friend back to its home in the ocean!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Back into the ocean?
How?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. Leave that to the great Emu☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's all say farewell to our friend, everyone! Three, two, one, wonderhoy!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! It turned into blue confetti...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, it's so pretty!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It is...!
It's like the stage is the ocean now...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mr. Fishy made it back to the ocean!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Thank goodness, they made it back! We did it, Saki! We can do our real performance now!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And Mr. Fishy being back home in the ocean means our magic show must sadly come to an end!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks, everyone! We hope you enjoyed it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Bye bye!!
se_event_summer_2021_006

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you for being so patient!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, thank you both. How did you come up with that act so fast...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hona! Kohane!
You made it!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm so glad you're both back!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Luckily, Saki did super duper good, so everything went really smoothly!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho helped too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hardly. Well, maybe a little...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I see...
Thank you so much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Now then, shall we get ready?

rows.Speaker: Kohane & Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks, Miku. That magic show was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<You're very welcome!
I'm glad everyone liked it♪>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I hope your song goes just as well! I'll be cheering for you, Emu!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!!
It's gonna be amazing!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, I'm back.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Shiho!
Where were you?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Something came up and...
se_event_summer_2021_007

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I think they're about to start!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (This is it...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We practiced so much. On top of that, Emu and Saki did a second performance for us. I have to give this everything I have...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We really appreciate your patience, everyone! I hope you enjoy our performance!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We'll be singing a really wonderhoy song for you!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ready, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ready!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
We'll be performing...!
BEST SUMMER!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Okay, sing like Amy. Sing like you want to make up with Dorothy...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (And Dorothy wants to tell Amy how happy she is about wanting to make up...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Yes, Dorothy's happy...!
All that's left is to sing and make up...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (They sound incredible. I can tell how happy they are and how much fun they're having... I need to keep pushing...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Oh, I know. What if I try throwing in something like this? It should make this song sound a lot more fun...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Did Saki just improvise...?
It fit in perfectly, like it was meant for this song.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I have to keep trying too...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: They've never done anything like this during practice...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They're in perfect sync...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This is so cool! I can't believe I'm here to see this!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Our music's being woven into a coherent story...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Is this how a musical is supposed to sound...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Let's keep this up until the end...!)
